caption: An elegant anime character illustration designed as a collectible character poster, portrait canvas. A single adult woman personifying DeepSeek stands in a graceful three-quarter pose, framed from her head to below her knees. She has long flowing midnight-blue hair with luminous azure tips, bright blue eyes, a little curved hair tuft, and small whale-fin-shaped hair accessories. Her refined navy-blue Victorian maid dress has a high white collar, white lace cuffs, a fitted white apron embroidered with one small blue whale, a dark blue ribbon at the neck and many carefully drawn ruffles. A large smooth blue whale tail curls behind her silhouette. She smiles with quiet confidence and holds one palm up beneath a tiny luminous floating blue whale. Her other hand gently gathers one edge of her skirt. She is clearly an adult, with mature facial proportions and a modest outfit. The setting is an ethereal underwater observatory with deep indigo arches, drifting bubbles, gentle cyan caustic light and distant translucent whales. Professional Japanese animation key visual, precise delicate linework, rich cel shading, painterly translucent hair, soft rim light and intricate fabric details. Restrained coherent palette of cobalt, midnight blue, pearl white and cyan. Airy balanced composition, character occupies the central lower area, a clean dark indigo area at the upper left contains a large beautifully typeset white English heading reading exactly "DEEPSEEK" and a smaller line beneath it reading exactly "DIVE INTO IDEAS". All wording is English. Sharp expressive face, clear hands, dramatic yet welcoming atmosphere, polished editorial anime poster.
